test.name: Record mode logs one entry per researcher verdict and returns the accepted logId
test.description: Second spawn: the researcher accepted the 1870 census hint (M70C), rejected the 1880 census hint (M80C), and accepted the death certificate (MDEF), which is already extracted as src_004 and linked to Patrick by pe_005. The agent logs exactly two entries — tool person_record_matches, plan_item_id null, positive for M70C and negative for M80C — logs nothing for MDEF (its source already carries the evidence, and a positive entry with no new assertion would send /research back to record-extraction for a record it holds), and returns M70C as {ark, logId}. It extracts nothing and links nothing (issue #2029).

input.delegation:
The researcher has decided on Patrick Flynn's hints. Record their verdicts.

personId: LZNY-BRF
verdicts: [{"ark": "https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M70C", "verdict": "accept"}, {"ark": "https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M80C", "verdict": "reject"}, {"ark": "https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MDEF", "verdict": "accept"}]
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Exactly two new log entries: one for M70C with outcome positive, one for M80C with outcome negative. Both have tool person_record_matches and plan_item_id null
No log entry for MDEF: the death certificate is already extracted as src_004 and linked by pe_005, so accepting it adds no new evidence and needs no extraction
The outcomes follow the researcher's verdicts as given — not the agent's own view of the hints
The return names the accepted M70C hint's ark and its log id, so record-extraction can reuse that log entry
No extraction, no person_evidence link, no tree edit
